metadata.title: Medora: An open-source bilingual platform for consent-aware health-record management and appointment coordination
metadata.description: Medora is open-source research software for bilingual health-record management, human-reviewed prescription digitization, specialty navigation, and transactionally safe appointment coordination. It is not a clinically validated medical device.
metadata.notes: Research software. Not a clinically validated medical device. The prescription image corpus is not included in this archive; see samples/DATA_USE_NOTICE.md.
